= Citation Pattern Integration Guide =
== From Grokpedia Research to BITwiki Evidence-Epistemics ==

'''Version:''' 2.0 | '''Date:''' 2026-02-12 | '''Source:''' Grokpedia Research (95 articles analyzed)

----
== Executive Summary ==

This guide integrates Grokpedia citation pattern research into BITwiki's Evidence-Epistemics framework. Analysis of Grokpedia articles reveals consistent citation practices that inform BITwiki's source hierarchy and quality benchmarks.

=== Key Research Findings ===

| Metric | Grokpedia Pattern | BITwiki Adaptation |
|--------|-------------------|-------------------|
| Citation Distribution | 12.6% high (>200), 40% medium, 47.4% low | Tiered quality expectations |
| Internal Link Density | 4.6 per 1000 chars | Maintain contextual linking |
| Universal Sections | References (100%), See Also (94%), External Links (91%) | Mandatory sections |

----
== 1. Citation System Architecture ==

=== 1.1 Numeric Citation Format ===

'''Grokpedia Pattern:'''
```
Text with claim[1] and another claim[2].
```

'''BITwiki Implementation:'''
```
BITwiki uses standard Wikipedia-style numeric citations with semantic enhancements:

Text with established claim[[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki#Tier_1|1]] and 
preliminary finding[[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki#Tier_3|2]].
```

'''Key Characteristics:'''
* Sequential numbering within articles
* Superscript formatting
* Linked to References section
* Consistent across all article types
* Enhanced with epistemic tier indicators

=== 1.2 Citation Quality Indicators ===

Rather than arbitrary density requirements, BITwiki evaluates citations by:

| Quality Dimension | Indicator | Assessment |
|-------------------|-----------|------------|
| Source Diversity | Multiple independent sources | Preferred over single-source dependency |
| Epistemic Tier | Tier 1-5 classification | Higher tiers for exceptional claims |
| Temporal Coverage | Historical vs current | Context-appropriate sourcing |
| Verification Status | Auditable references | Traceable to origin |

----
== 2. Section Structure Integration ==

=== 2.1 Header Hierarchy Standards ===

'''Grokpedia Analysis:'''
| Level | Count | Percentage |
|-------|-------|------------|
| H2 | 682 | 67.2% |
| H3 | 1172 | 27.6% |
| H4 | 0 | 5.2% |

'''BITwiki Implementation:'''
```
Article Structure:
├── H1: Article Title (1)
├── H2: Major Sections (10-15)
│ ├── H3: Subsections (3-5 per H2)
│ │ └── H4: Detailed points (optional)
```

'''Structural Guidance:'''
| Metric | Target |
|--------|--------|
| Total Sections | Context-dependent |
| H2 Sections | Primary divisions |
| H3 Sections | Subordinate divisions |
| H4 Sections | Granular detail (as needed) |

=== 2.2 Universal Section Requirements ===

'''Mandatory Sections:'''
# '''References''' - Standard citation list with epistemic markers
# '''See Also''' - Internal link suggestions (context-appropriate quantity)
# '''External Links''' - Outbound resources (curated selection)

'''Common Content Sections:'''

| Section | Frequency | BITwiki Priority |
|---------|-----------|------------------|
| History | 70.5% | High |
| Overview | 56.8% | High |
| Specifications | 50.5% | High (technical) |
| Design | 47.4% | Medium |
| Development | 44.2% | Medium |
| Applications | 40.0% | High |
| Variants | 36.8% | Low |
| Performance | 33.7% | Medium |

----
== 3. Source Hierarchy Integration ==

=== 3.1 Tier 1: Established Sources (Highest Confidence) ===

'''Grokpedia Pattern:''' Academic papers, official documentation, primary sources

'''BITwiki Implementation:'''
```
Tier 1 Sources (Confidence: 80-100%):
├── Peer-reviewed research (reputable journals)
├── Official protocol documentation
├── Primary source materials
├── Expert consensus statements
└── Government data/statistics

Citation Format: [[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki#Tier_1|1]]
```

'''Requirements:'''
* Multiple independent sources preferred
* Methodology transparent
* Peer review verified
* Conflicts of interest disclosed

=== 3.2 Tier 2: Well-Supported Sources ===

'''Grokpedia Pattern:''' Quality journalism, expert blogs, technical reviews

'''BITwiki Implementation:'''
```
Tier 2 Sources (Confidence: 60-79%):
├── Quality journalism (fact-checked)
├── Expert-authored publications
├── Think tank reports (transparent methodology)
├── Industry reports (conflicts noted)
└── Technical documentation

Citation Format: [[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki#Tier_2|2]]
```

=== 3.3 Tier 3-5: Lower Confidence Sources ===

| Tier | Confidence | Source Types | Usage |
|------|------------|--------------|-------|
| Tier 3 | 40-59% | Community sources, forums | Context only |
| Tier 4 | 20-39% | Opinion pieces, blogs | Labeled as opinion |
| Tier 5 | 0-19% | Unverified claims | Flag for review |

----
== 4. Internal Linking Patterns ==

=== 4.1 Link Density Standards ===

'''Grokpedia Metric:''' 4.6 links per 1000 characters

'''BITwiki Implementation:'''
```
Target: Contextual internal linking
Guidance: Link first mention of key concepts
Maximum: Avoid clutter through editorial judgment
```

'''Link Distribution:'''
| Link Type | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| Concept Links | Define key concepts |
| Entity Links | Reference organizations, people |
| Protocol Links | Technical specifications |
| Event Links | Historical context |

=== 4.2 Link Quality Guidelines ===

'''Required:'''
* First mention of key concept must be linked
* Links to existing BITwiki articles preferred
* External links for source verification
* Semantic relationship indicated

'''Prohibited:'''
* Over-linking (same term multiple times)
* Broken links (validate quarterly)
* Circular references
* Orphaned pages

----
== 5. Citation Templates ==

=== 5.1 Standard Citation Template ===

```
== References ==

{{BITwiki_References
 | style = numeric
 | sort = appearance
}}

# {{BITwiki_Citation
 | tier = 1
 | type = academic
 | authors = Nakamoto, Satoshi
 | title = Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System
 | date = 2008-10-31
 | url = https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf
 | access_date = 2026-02-09
 | confidence = established
}}

# {{BITwiki_Citation
 | tier = 2
 | type = technical
 | authors = Ethereum Foundation
 | title = Ethereum Whitepaper
 | date = 2014
 | url = https://ethereum.org/whitepaper
 | access_date = 2026-02-09
 | confidence = well_supported
}}
```

=== 5.2 Epistemic Status Markers ===

| Status | Marker | Usage |
|--------|--------|-------|
| Established | {{Established}} | Tier 1 sources, consensus |
| Well Supported | {{WellSupported}} | Tier 2, multiple sources |
| Supported | {{Supported}} | Tier 3, some evidence |
| Preliminary | {{Preliminary}} | Early evidence |
| Speculative | {{Speculative}} | Hypothesis, conjecture |
| Disputed | {{Disputed}} | Credible disagreement |

----
== 6. Quality Framework ==

=== 6.1 Article Quality Indicators ===

Rather than rigid citation counts, quality emerges from:

| Dimension | Indicator |
|-----------|-----------|
| Source Quality | Tier 1-2 sources for claims |
| Coverage | All factual claims cited |
| Diversity | Multiple source types |
| Recency | Current where applicable |
| Verifiability | Auditable references |

=== 6.2 Pre-Publication Checklist ===

'''Citation Requirements:'''
* [ ] Tier 1 sources for exceptional claims
* [ ] All factual claims cited
* [ ] References section complete
* [ ] External links verified

'''Link Requirements:'''
* [ ] First mentions linked
* [ ] See Also section populated
* [ ] No broken links

'''Structure Requirements:'''
* [ ] References section present
* [ ] See Also section present
* [ ] External Links section present
* [ ] Proper header hierarchy

----
== 7. Integration with BITwiki Systems ==

=== 7.1 Evidence-Epistemics Framework ===

'''Integration Points:'''
* [[BITwiki_Evidence_Framework.wiki]] - Citation requirements
* [[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki]] - Tier definitions
* [[BITwiki_Claim_Validation.wiki]] - Validation workflows
* [[BITwiki_Epistemic_Tiers.wiki]] - Confidence levels
* [[BITwiki_Uncertainty_Markers.wiki]] - Status markers

=== 7.2 Schema Matter Integration ===

'''Template References:'''
* [[Template:BITwiki_Citation]] - Citation formatting
* [[Template:BITwiki_References]] - Reference section
* [[Template:BITwiki_Source]] - Source infobox

=== 7.3 Governance Integration ===

'''Quality Assurance:'''
* [[BITwiki_Editorial_Board.wiki]] - Review standards
* [[BITwiki_Policy_Catalog.wiki]] - Citation policies
* [[BITwiki_Quality_Bar.wiki]] - Quality thresholds

----
== 8. Success Metrics ==

| Metric | Target | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Tier 1 Source % | >40% | Quarterly review |
| Link Density | Contextual | Automated check |
| Broken Links | <1% | Weekly scan |
| Citation Coverage | 100% of claims | Random sampling |

----
== 9. References ==

# Grokpedia Research: `hyperion/research/grokpedia/citation_patterns.md`
# Grokpedia Research: `hyperion/research/grokpedia/sitemap_analysis.md`
# Grokpedia Research: `hyperion/research/grokpedia/integration_recommendations.md`
# BITwiki Evidence Framework: [[BITwiki_Evidence_and_Epistemics.wiki]]
# BITwiki Source Hierarchy: [[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki]]

----

# Grokpedia Research: `hyperion/research/grokpedia/sitemap_analysis.md`

# BITwiki Evidence Framework: [[BITwiki_Evidence_and_Epistemics.wiki]]
# BITwiki Source Hierarchy: [[BITwiki_Source_Hierarchy.wiki]]

 | access_date = 2026-02-09
 | confidence = well_supported
}}
```

=== 5.2 Epistemic Status Markers ===

| Status | Marker | Usage |
|--------|--------|-------|
| Established | {{Established}} | Tier 1 sources, consensus |
| Well Supported | {{WellSupported}} | Tier 2, multiple sources |
| Supported | {{Supported}} | Tier 3, some evidence |
| Preliminary | {{Preliminary}} | Early evidence |
| Speculative | {{Speculative}} | Hypothesis, conjecture |
| Disputed | {{Disputed}} | Credible disagreement |

== 6. Quality Framework ==

=== 6.1 Article Quality Indicators ===

Rather than rigid citation counts, quality emerges from:

| Dimension | Indicator |
|-----------|-----------|
| Source Quality | Tier 1-2 sources for claims |
| Coverage | All factual claims cited |
| Diversity | Multiple source types |
| Recency | Current where applicable |
| Verifiability | Auditable references |

=== 6.2 Pre-Publication Checklist ===

'''Citation Requirements:'''
* [ ] Tier 1 sources for exceptional claims
* [ ] All factual claims cited
* [ ] References section complete
* [ ] External links verified

'''Link Requirements:'''
* [ ] First mentions linked
* [ ] See Also section populated
* [ ] No broken links

'''Structure Requirements:'''
* [ ] References section present
* [ ] See Also section present
* [ ] External Links section present
* [ ] Proper header hierarchy
